title: Microplastics React With Water, a New Study Says. That’s a Problem for Biology
summary: So how can microplastics be so reactive when bigger plastics generally aren’t? Research into the effects of microplastics has long focused on other chemicals leaching from the particles or on their physical effects, often considering the plastic itself chemically inert.
